instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem:
An adult in the last days of life has known intra-abdominal cancer, intermittent colicky abdominal pain, increasing distention, feculent vomiting, and no stool or flatus for 3 days. The prescriber has confirmed an obstructive bowel disorder. The goals are comfort, and no curative surgical pathway is planned. Comfort measures and symptom-control medication orders are available.

Complete the bowtie by selecting the most likely condition, the 2 priority actions, and the 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Administer the prescribed hyoscine butylbromide and ordered antiemetic regimen

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Review reversible or mechanical contributors and use goal-concordant nonpharmacologic comfort measures

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Start a stimulant laxative and high-fiber oral intake

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Begin prescribed octreotide immediately before a trial of hyoscine butylbromide

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Comfort, sedation, mouth dryness, and hydration burden

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Vomiting frequency, abdominal distention, and colicky pain
